query:
select
to_char(registration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Registration date",
count(
case when sex = 'Male' then 1 end
) as "Total patients (male)",
count(
case when sex = 'Female' then 1 end
) as "Total patients (female)"
from "reporting"."ds__patients"
where
registration_date >= 
:fromDate
and
registration_date <= 
:toDate
group by registration_date
name: Registered patients daily summary
notes: This report generates a summary of the number of patients that have been registered by date and sex for the selected date range.
